newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MANILA'S ULTRANA CHANGES NAME, PURPOSE.
newsitem.headline: MANILA'S ULTRANA CHANGES NAME, PURPOSE.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved the conversion of Ultrana Energy Resources Corp into a holding firm and the change in its corporate name, the company said on Friday.
The former mining company will be named F&J Prince Holdings Corp. The firm's par value will also be changed to one peso per share from one centavo apiece.
The changes will be reflected in the stock exchange's computer system on August 13, the company added.
